title: Health-check coverage and startup
summary: Engine health has starting, healthy and unhealthy states when an image or container config defines a health check. Unhealthy reflects that check contract; absence and startup leave this health predicate unmeasured.
checks: Confirm the configured health check is representative and its startup budget is appropriate.
Check its dependency route separately from the affected application vantage.
limitations: The collector does not execute a check, retain health output or verify business correctness.
